<!DOCTYPE html>
<html lang="en">
<head>
<meta charset="UTF-8">
<meta name="viewport" content="width=device-width, initial-scale=1.0">
<title>Vantor Automotive — Drive the Future</title>
<link rel="preconnect" href="https://fonts.googleapis.com">
<link rel="preconnect" href="https://fonts.gstatic.com" crossorigin>
<link href="https://fonts.googleapis.com/css2?family=Montserrat:wght@100;200;300;400;500;600;700;800;900&family=Poppins:wght@300;400;500;600&display=swap" rel="stylesheet">
<style>
  /* ===== CSS VARIABLES ===== */
  :root {
    --bg: #0B1220;
    --royal: #1E3A8A;
    --sky: #60A5FA;
    --electric: #3B82F6;
    --silver: #E5E7EB;
    --neon: #22D3EE;
    --purple: #6366F1;
    --glass: rgba(255,255,255,0.04);
    --glass-border: rgba(96,165,250,0.15);
    --glow-blue: 0 0 30px rgba(59,130,246,0.4);
    --glow-neon: 0 0 30px rgba(34,211,238,0.5);
    --glow-purple: 0 0 30px rgba(99,102,241,0.4);
  }

  /* ===== RESET & BASE ===== */
  *, *::before, *::after { margin: 0; padding: 0; box-sizing: border-box; }
  html { scroll-behavior: smooth; }
  body {
    font-family: 'Poppins', sans-serif;
    background: var(--bg);
    color: var(--silver);
    overflow-x: hidden;
    cursor: none;
  }

  /* ===== CUSTOM CURSOR ===== */
  .cursor {
    width: 12px; height: 12px;
    background: var(--neon);
    border-radius: 50%;
    position: fixed; top: 0; left: 0;
    pointer-events: none; z-index: 9999;
    transform: translate(-50%,-50%);
    transition: transform 0.1s, width 0.3s, height 0.3s, background 0.3s;
    box-shadow: var(--glow-neon);
  }
  .cursor-ring {
    width: 36px; height: 36px;
    border: 1.5px solid rgba(34,211,238,0.5);
    border-radius: 50%;
    position: fixed; top: 0; left: 0;
    pointer-events: none; z-index: 9998;
    transform: translate(-50%,-50%);
    transition: transform 0.15s ease, width 0.3s, height 0.3s, border-color 0.3s;
  }
  body:hover .cursor { opacity: 1; }

  /* ===== NOISE TEXTURE OVERLAY ===== */
  body::before {
    content: '';
    position: fixed; inset: 0;
    background-image: url("data:image/svg+xml,%3Csvg viewBox='0 0 512 512' xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg'%3E%3Cfilter id='noise'%3E%3CfeTurbulence type='fractalNoise' baseFrequency='0.75' numOctaves='4' stitchTiles='stitch'/%3E%3C/filter%3E%3Crect width='100%25' height='100%25' filter='url(%23noise)'/%3E%3C/svg%3E");
    opacity: 0.025;
    pointer-events: none;
    z-index: 1000;
  }

  /* ===== NAV ===== */
  nav {
    position: fixed; top: 0; left: 0; right: 0; z-index: 999;
    display: flex; align-items: center; justify-content: space-between;
    padding: 0 5%;
    height: 72px;
    background: rgba(11,18,32,0.7);
    backdrop-filter: blur(20px);
    border-bottom: 1px solid var(--glass-border);
    transition: all 0.4s ease;
  }
  nav.scrolled { background: rgba(11,18,32,0.95); height: 60px; }
  .nav-logo {
    font-family: 'Montserrat', sans-serif;
    font-weight: 800;
    font-size: 1.5rem;
    letter-spacing: 0.15em;
    background: linear-gradient(135deg, var(--sky), var(--neon));
    -webkit-background-clip: text; -webkit-text-fill-color: transparent;
    text-decoration: none;
  }
  .nav-logo span { color: var(--purple); -webkit-text-fill-color: var(--purple); }
  .nav-links {
    display: flex; gap: 2.5rem; list-style: none;
  }
  .nav-links a {
    font-size: 0.82rem;
    font-weight: 500;
    letter-spacing: 0.1em;
    text-transform: uppercase;
    color: rgba(229,231,235,0.7);
    text-decoration: none;
    position: relative;
    transition: color 0.3s;
  }
  .nav-links a::after {
    content: '';
    position: absolute; bottom: -4px; left: 0; right: 0; height: 1px;
    background: var(--neon);
    transform: scaleX(0);
    transition: transform 0.3s ease;
    box-shadow: var(--glow-neon);
  }
  .nav-links a:hover { color: var(--neon); }
  .nav-links a:hover::after { transform: scaleX(1); }
  .nav-cta {
    display: flex; gap: 1rem; align-items: center;
  }
  .btn-nav {
    padding: 0.5rem 1.4rem;
    font-size: 0.78rem;
    font-weight: 600;
    letter-spacing: 0.08em;
    text-transform: uppercase;
    border-radius: 2px;
    cursor: pointer;
    transition: all 0.3s ease;
    font-family: 'Montserrat', sans-serif;
  }
  .btn-ghost {
    background: transparent;
    border: 1px solid var(--glass-border);
    color: var(--silver);
  }
  .btn-ghost:hover {
    border-color: var(--sky);
    color: var(--sky);
    box-shadow: 0 0 15px rgba(96,165,250,0.2);
  }
  .btn-primary {
    background: linear-gradient(135deg, var(--electric), var(--purple));
    border: none;
    color: #fff;
    box-shadow: 0 0 20px rgba(59,130,246,0.3);
  }
  .btn-primary:hover {
    transform: translateY(-1px);
    box-shadow: 0 0 35px rgba(59,130,246,0.6), 0 0 60px rgba(99,102,241,0.3);
  }

  /* HAMBURGER */
  .hamburger {
    display: none; flex-direction: column; gap: 5px;
    cursor: pointer; padding: 5px;
  }
  .hamburger span {
    display: block; width: 24px; height: 2px;
    background: var(--silver);
    transition: all 0.3s;
  }
  .mobile-menu {
    display: none;
    position: fixed; inset: 0; top: 72px;
    background: rgba(11,18,32,0.97);
    backdrop-filter: blur(30px);
    z-index: 998;
    flex-direction: column; align-items: center; justify-content: center;
    gap: 2.5rem;
  }
  .mobile-menu.open { display: flex; }
  .mobile-menu a {
    font-family: 'Montserrat', sans-serif;
    font-size: 1.5rem;
    font-weight: 700;
    letter-spacing: 0.2em;
    text-transform: uppercase;
    color: var(--silver);
    text-decoration: none;
    transition: color 0.3s;
  }
  .mobile-menu a:hover { color: var(--neon); }

  /* ===== HERO ===== */
  #hero {
    position: relative;
    height: 100vh; min-height: 700px;
    display: flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center;
    overflow: hidden;
  }
  .hero-video-wrap {
    position: absolute; inset: 0; z-index: 0;
  }
  .hero-video-wrap iframe {
    width: 100%; height: 100%;
    object-fit: cover;
    pointer-events: none;
    transform: scale(1.08);
    filter: brightness(0.35) saturate(1.2);
  }
  /* Fallback car image if video fails */
  /* Hero slideshow */
  .hero-bg-img {
    position: absolute; inset: 0;
    z-index: 0;
  }
  .hero-slide {
    position: absolute; inset: 0;
    background-size: cover;
    background-position: center;
    opacity: 0;
    transition: opacity 1.6s ease, transform 8s ease;
    transform: scale(1.08);
    filter: brightness(0.28) saturate(1.35);
  }
  .hero-slide.active {
    opacity: 1;
    transform: scale(1);
  }
  /* Slide dots */
  .hero-dots {
    position: absolute; bottom: 5rem; right: 5%;
    z-index: 4;
    display: flex; flex-direction: column; gap: 0.5rem;
  }
  .hero-dot {
    width: 2px; height: 20px;
    background: rgba(229,231,235,0.25);
    border-radius: 2px;
    cursor: pointer;
    transition: all 0.4s;
  }
  .hero-dot.active {
    background: var(--neon);
    height: 36px;
    box-shadow: 0 0 10px rgba(34,211,238,0.6);
  }
  .hero-overlay {
    position: absolute; inset: 0; z-index: 1;
    background: linear-gradient(
      135deg,
      rgba(11,18,32,0.85) 0%,
      rgba(30,58,138,0.3) 50%,
      rgba(99,102,241,0.2) 100%
    );
  }
  .hero-glow-l {
    position: absolute; left: -10%; top: 20%;
    width: 600px; height: 600px;
    background: radial-gradient(circle, rgba(59,130,246,0.15) 0%, transparent 70%);
    z-index: 2;
    animation: pulse-glow 4s ease-in-out infinite;
  }
  .hero-glow-r {
    position: absolute; right: -10%; bottom: 10%;
    width: 500px; height: 500px;
    background: radial-gradient(circle, rgba(99,102,241,0.12) 0%, transparent 70%);
    z-index: 2;
    animation: pulse-glow 5s ease-in-out infinite reverse;
  }
  @keyframes pulse-glow {
    0%, 100% { opacity: 0.6; transform: scale(1); }
    50% { opacity: 1; transform: scale(1.1); }
  }
  .hero-content {
    position: relative; z-index: 3;
    text-align: center;
    padding: 0 1.5rem;
    max-width: 900px;
  }
  .hero-badge {
    display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: 0.5rem;
    padding: 0.4rem 1.2rem;
    border: 1px solid rgba(34,211,238,0.3);
    border-radius: 100px;
    font-size: 0.72rem;
    font-weight: 500;
    letter-spacing: 0.2em;
    text-transform: uppercase;
    color: var(--neon);
    margin-bottom: 2rem;
    background: rgba(34,211,238,0.05);
    backdrop-filter: blur(10px);
    animation: fadeSlideDown 1s ease both;
  }
  .hero-badge::before {
    content: '';
    width: 6px; height: 6px;
    background: var(--neon);
    border-radius: 50%;
    box-shadow: var(--glow-neon);
    animation: blink 1.5s infinite;
  }
  @keyframes blink { 0%,100%{opacity:1} 50%{opacity:0.3} }
  .hero-title {
    font-family: 'Montserrat', sans-serif;
    font-size: clamp(3.5rem, 9vw, 8rem);
    font-weight: 900;
    line-height: 0.95;
    letter-spacing: -0.02em;
    margin-bottom: 1.5rem;
    animation: fadeSlideUp 1s 0.2s ease both;
  }
  .hero-title .line1 {
    display: block;
    color: var(--silver);
  }
  .hero-title .line2 {
    display: block;
    background: linear-gradient(135deg, var(--sky) 0%, var(--neon) 50%, var(--purple) 100%);
    -webkit-background-clip: text; -webkit-text-fill-color: transparent;
    filter: drop-shadow(0 0 30px rgba(34,211,238,0.4));
  }
  .hero-sub {
    font-size: clamp(0.9rem, 2vw, 1.15rem);
    font-weight: 300;
    letter-spacing: 0.3em;
    text-transform: uppercase;
    color: rgba(229,231,235,0.6);
    margin-bottom: 3rem;
    animation: fadeSlideUp 1s 0.4s ease both;
  }
  .hero-sub span { color: var(--neon); }
  .hero-buttons {
    display: flex; gap: 1.2rem; justify-content: center; flex-wrap: wrap;
    animation: fadeSlideUp 1s 0.6s ease both;
  }
  .btn-hero-primary {
    padding: 1rem 2.8rem;
    font-family: 'Montserrat', sans-serif;
    font-size: 0.82rem;
    font-weight: 700;
    letter-spacing: 0.15em;
    text-transform: uppercase;
    background: linear-gradient(135deg, var(--electric), var(--purple));
    color: #fff;
    border: none;
    border-radius: 3px;
    cursor: pointer;
    transition: all 0.4s ease;
    box-shadow: 0 0 30px rgba(59,130,246,0.4), inset 0 1px 0 rgba(255,255,255,0.1);
    text-decoration: none;
    display: inline-block;
  }
  .btn-hero-primary:hover {
    transform: translateY(-3px);
    box-shadow: 0 0 60px rgba(59,130,246,0.7), 0 0 100px rgba(99,102,241,0.3);
  }
  .btn-hero-ghost {
    padding: 1rem 2.8rem;
    font-family: 'Montserrat', sans-serif;
    font-size: 0.82rem;
    font-weight: 600;
    letter-spacing: 0.15em;
    text-transform: uppercase;
    background: transparent;
    color: var(--silver);
    border: 1px solid rgba(96,165,250,0.35);
    border-radius: 3px;
    cursor: pointer;
    transition: all 0.4s ease;
    text-decoration: none;
    display: inline-block;
    backdrop-filter: blur(10px);
  }
  .btn-hero-ghost:hover {
    border-color: var(--neon);
    color: var(--neon);
    box-shadow: 0 0 30px rgba(34,211,238,0.25);
    transform: translateY(-3px);
  }
  .hero-scroll {
    position: absolute; bottom: 2.5rem; left: 50%;
    transform: translateX(-50%);
    z-index: 3;
    display: flex; flex-direction: column; align-items: center; gap: 0.5rem;
    animation: fadeSlideUp 1s 1s ease both;
  }
  .hero-scroll span {
    font-size: 0.65rem; letter-spacing: 0.2em; text-transform: uppercase;
    color: rgba(229,231,235,0.4);
  }
  .scroll-line {
    width: 1px; height: 50px;
    background: linear-gradient(to bottom, var(--neon), transparent);
    animation: scrollPulse 2s ease-in-out infinite;
  }
  @keyframes scrollPulse { 0%,100%{opacity:0.3;transform:scaleY(1)} 50%{opacity:1;transform:scaleY(1.2)} }

  /* STATS BAR */
  .stats-bar {
    background: rgba(30,58,138,0.15);
    border-top: 1px solid var(--glass-border);
    border-bottom: 1px solid var(--glass-border);
    backdrop-filter: blur(20px);
    padding: 2rem 5%;
    display: flex; justify-content: center; gap: clamp(2rem, 6vw, 6rem);
    flex-wrap: wrap;
  }
  .stat-item { text-align: center; }
  .stat-num {
    font-family: 'Montserrat', sans-serif;
    font-size: clamp(1.8rem, 4vw, 2.8rem);
    font-weight: 800;
    background: linear-gradient(135deg, var(--sky), var(--neon));
    -webkit-background-clip: text; -webkit-text-fill-color: transparent;
    display: block;
    line-height: 1;
  }
  .stat-label {
    font-size: 0.72rem; letter-spacing: 0.2em;
    text-transform: uppercase; color: rgba(229,231,235,0.5);
    margin-top: 0.3rem;
  }

  /* ===== SECTION BASE ===== */
  section { padding: 8rem 5%; }
  .section-tag {
    font-size: 0.72rem; font-weight: 600;
    letter-spacing: 0.3em; text-transform: uppercase;
    color: var(--neon);
    margin-bottom: 1rem;
    display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 0.75rem;
  }
  .section-tag::before {
    content: '';
    width: 30px; height: 1px;
    background: var(--neon);
    box-shadow: var(--glow-neon);
  }
  .section-title {
    font-family: 'Montserrat', sans-serif;
    font-size: clamp(2rem, 5vw, 3.5rem);
    font-weight: 800;
    line-height: 1.1;
    color: var(--silver);
    margin-bottom: 1.2rem;
  }
  .section-title .accent {
    background: linear-gradient(135deg, var(--sky), var(--neon));
    -webkit-background-clip: text; -webkit-text-fill-color: transparent;
  }
  .section-sub {
    font-size: 1rem; color: rgba(229,231,235,0.55);
    max-width: 550px; line-height: 1.8;
  }

  /* ===== MODELS SECTION ===== */
  #models { background: rgba(30,58,138,0.04); }
  .models-header { text-align: center; margin-bottom: 4rem; }
  .models-header .section-sub { margin: 0 auto; }
  .models-grid {
    display: grid;
    grid-template-columns: repeat(auto-fit, minmax(300px, 1fr));
    gap: 1.5rem;
    max-width: 1400px; margin: 0 auto;
  }
  .car-card {
    position: relative;
    border-radius: 6px;
    overflow: hidden;
    border: 1px solid var(--glass-border);
    background: var(--glass);
    cursor: pointer;
    transition: all 0.5s cubic-bezier(0.25, 0.46, 0.45, 0.94);
  }
  .car-card:hover {
    transform: translateY(-10px) scale(1.01);
    border-color: rgba(34,211,238,0.4);
    box-shadow: 0 20px 60px rgba(0,0,0,0.4), 0 0 40px rgba(34,211,238,0.15);
  }
  .car-card-img {
    width: 100%; height: 240px;
    object-fit: cover;
    transition: transform 0.6s ease;
    filter: brightness(0.85) saturate(1.1);
  }
  .car-card:hover .car-card-img {
    transform: scale(1.08);
    filter: brightness(1) saturate(1.3);
  }
  .car-card-body {
    padding: 1.5rem;
    background: linear-gradient(135deg, rgba(11,18,32,0.9), rgba(30,58,138,0.1));
    backdrop-filter: blur(10px);
  }
  .car-badge {
    font-size: 0.65rem; font-weight: 700;
    letter-spacing: 0.2em; text-transform: uppercase;
    color: var(--neon);
    margin-bottom: 0.5rem;
    display: block;
  }
  .car-name {
    font-family: 'Montserrat', sans-serif;
    font-size: 1.4rem; font-weight: 800;
    color: var(--silver); margin-bottom: 0.4rem;
  }
  .car-tagline {
    font-size: 0.82rem; color: rgba(229,231,235,0.5);
    margin-bottom: 1.2rem;
  }
  .car-specs {
    display: flex; gap: 1.5rem; margin-bottom: 1.3rem;
  }
  .spec { text-align: left; }
  .spec-val {
    font-family: 'Montserrat', sans-serif;
    font-size: 1.1rem; font-weight: 700;
    color: var(--sky);
  }
  .spec-key { font-size: 0.65rem; color: rgba(229,231,235,0.4); letter-spacing: 0.1em; text-transform: uppercase; }
  .car-price {
    font-family: 'Montserrat', sans-serif;
    font-size: 1.6rem; font-weight: 800;
    background: linear-gradient(135deg, var(--sky), var(--neon));
    -webkit-background-clip: text; -webkit-text-fill-color: transparent;
  }
  .car-btn {
    width: 100%; padding: 0.8rem;
    margin-top: 1rem;
    font-family: 'Montserrat', sans-serif;
    font-size: 0.75rem; font-weight: 700;
    letter-spacing: 0.15em; text-transform: uppercase;
    background: transparent;
    border: 1px solid rgba(96,165,250,0.3);
    color: var(--sky);
    border-radius: 3px;
    cursor: pointer;
    transition: all 0.3s;
  }
  .car-btn:hover {
    background: rgba(59,130,246,0.1);
    border-color: var(--sky);
    box-shadow: 0 0 20px rgba(96,165,250,0.25);
  }
  .car-glow {
    position: absolute; inset: 0;
    pointer-events: none;
    opacity: 0;
    transition: opacity 0.4s;
    background: radial-gradient(ellipse at 50% 80%, rgba(34,211,238,0.1) 0%, transparent 70%);
  }
  .car-card:hover .car-glow { opacity: 1; }

  /* ===== EXPERIENCE / VIDEO SECTION ===== */
  #experience {
    background: linear-gradient(180deg, var(--bg) 0%, rgba(30,58,138,0.1) 50%, var(--bg) 100%);
    text-align: center;
  }
  .experience-inner { max-width: 1000px; margin: 0 auto; }
  .experience-inner .section-tag { justify-content: center; }
  .experience-inner .section-sub { margin: 0 auto 3rem; }
  .video-frame {
    position: relative;
    border-radius: 8px;
    overflow: hidden;
    border: 1px solid var(--glass-border);
    box-shadow: 0 0 80px rgba(34,211,238,0.12), 0 0 40px rgba(59,130,246,0.12);
    aspect-ratio: 16/9;
  }
  .video-frame::before {
    content: '';
    position: absolute; inset: -1px;
    border-radius: 8px;
    background: linear-gradient(135deg, var(--neon), var(--electric), var(--purple));
    z-index: -1;
    animation: border-rotate 4s linear infinite;
    opacity: 0.5;
  }
  @keyframes border-rotate {
    0% { filter: hue-rotate(0deg); }
    100% { filter: hue-rotate(360deg); }
  }
  .video-frame iframe {
    width: 100%; height: 100%; border: none; display: block;
  }

  /* ===== ABOUT SECTION ===== */
  #about { max-width: 1400px; margin: 0 auto; }
  .about-grid {
    display: grid;
    grid-template-columns: 1fr 1fr;
    gap: 5rem; align-items: center;
  }
  .about-visual {
    position: relative;
    border-radius: 8px;
    overflow: hidden;
  }
  .about-img {
    width: 100%; border-radius: 8px;
    filter: brightness(0.75) saturate(1.2);
    transition: filter 0.5s;
    display: block;
  }
  .about-visual:hover .about-img { filter: brightness(0.9) saturate(1.4); }
  .about-visual-glow {
    position: absolute; inset: 0;
    background: linear-gradient(135deg, transparent 50%, rgba(34,211,238,0.08) 100%);
    border-radius: 8px;
  }
  .about-visual::after {
    content: '';
    position: absolute; inset: 0;
    border: 1px solid rgba(34,211,238,0.2);
    border-radius: 8px;
  }
  .about-pills {
    display: flex; flex-wrap: wrap; gap: 0.75rem;
    margin-top: 2rem;
  }
  .pill {
    padding: 0.5rem 1.2rem;
    border: 1px solid var(--glass-border);
    border-radius: 100px;
    font-size: 0.75rem; letter-spacing: 0.1em;
    color: var(--sky);
    background: rgba(96,165,250,0.05);
    backdrop-filter: blur(10px);
    transition: all 0.3s;
  }
  .pill:hover {
    border-color: var(--sky);
    background: rgba(96,165,250,0.12);
    box-shadow: 0 0 15px rgba(96,165,250,0.2);
  }
  .about-text p {
    color: rgba(229,231,235,0.6);
    line-height: 1.9;
    margin-bottom: 1.2rem;
    font-size: 0.95rem;
  }

  /* ===== BOOKING SECTION ===== */
  #booking {
    background: rgba(30,58,138,0.05);
    border-top: 1px solid var(--glass-border);
    border-bottom: 1px solid var(--glass-border);
  }
  .booking-inner { max-width: 800px; margin: 0 auto; text-align: center; }
  .booking-inner .section-tag { justify-content: center; }
  .booking-form {
    margin-top: 3rem;
    background: var(--glass);
    border: 1px solid var(--glass-border);
    border-radius: 8px;
    padding: 2.5rem;
    backdrop-filter: blur(20px);
    display: grid; gap: 1.5rem;
  }
  .form-row { display: grid; grid-template-columns: 1fr 1fr; gap: 1rem; }
  .form-group { text-align: left; }
  .form-label {
    font-size: 0.72rem; font-weight: 600;
    letter-spacing: 0.15em; text-transform: uppercase;
    color: rgba(229,231,235,0.5);
    display: block; margin-bottom: 0.5rem;
  }
  .form-control {
    width: 100%; padding: 0.85rem 1.1rem;
    background: rgba(11,18,32,0.8);
    border: 1px solid var(--glass-border);
    border-radius: 4px;
    color: var(--silver);
    font-family: 'Poppins', sans-serif;
    font-size: 0.9rem;
    outline: none;
    transition: all 0.3s;
    appearance: none;
  }
  .form-control:focus {
    border-color: var(--neon);
    box-shadow: 0 0 20px rgba(34,211,238,0.15);
  }
  .form-control option { background: #0e1829; }
  .booking-total {
    display: flex; justify-content: space-between; align-items: center;
    padding: 1.2rem;
    background: rgba(34,211,238,0.05);
    border: 1px solid rgba(34,211,238,0.15);
    border-radius: 4px;
  }
  .booking-total-label { font-size: 0.85rem; color: rgba(229,231,235,0.6); }
  .booking-total-price {
    font-family: 'Montserrat', sans-serif;
    font-size: 1.8rem; font-weight: 800;
    background: linear-gradient(135deg, var(--sky), var(--neon));
    -webkit-background-clip: text; -webkit-text-fill-color: transparent;
  }
  .btn-book {
    width: 100%; padding: 1.1rem;
    font-family: 'Montserrat', sans-serif;
    font-size: 0.9rem; font-weight: 700;
    letter-spacing: 0.2em; text-transform: uppercase;
    background: linear-gradient(135deg, var(--electric), var(--purple));
    border: none;
    border-radius: 4px;
    color: #fff;
    cursor: pointer;
    transition: all 0.4s;
    position: relative; overflow: hidden;
    box-shadow: 0 0 30px rgba(59,130,246,0.3);
  }
  .btn-book::before {
    content: '';
    position: absolute; top: 0; left: -100%; width: 100%; height: 100%;
    background: linear-gradient(90deg, transparent, rgba(255,255,255,0.1), transparent);
    transition: left 0.5s;
  }
  .btn-book:hover { box-shadow: 0 0 60px rgba(59,130,246,0.7), 0 0 100px rgba(99,102,241,0.3); transform: translateY(-2px); }
  .btn-book:hover::before { left: 100%; }
  .booking-success {
    display: none;
    text-align: center; padding: 2rem;
    color: var(--neon);
    font-family: 'Montserrat', sans-serif;
    font-size: 1.1rem; font-weight: 700;
    letter-spacing: 0.1em;
  }
  .booking-success .success-icon {
    font-size: 3rem; display: block; margin-bottom: 1rem;
  }

  /* ===== CONTACT SECTION ===== */
  #contact { text-align: center; }
  .contact-inner { max-width: 900px; margin: 0 auto; }
  .contact-inner .section-tag { justify-content: center; }
  .contact-inner .section-sub { margin: 0 auto 3rem; }
  .social-grid {
    display: flex; flex-wrap: wrap; justify-content: center; gap: 1rem;
    margin-bottom: 3rem;
  }
  .social-btn {
    display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 0.6rem;
    padding: 0.75rem 1.4rem;
    border: 1px solid var(--glass-border);
    border-radius: 4px;
    background: var(--glass);
    color: var(--silver);
    text-decoration: none;
    font-size: 0.8rem; font-weight: 500;
    transition: all 0.3s;
    backdrop-filter: blur(10px);
  }
  .social-btn:hover {
    border-color: var(--neon);
    color: var(--neon);
    transform: translateY(-3px);
    box-shadow: 0 0 20px rgba(34,211,238,0.2);
  }
  .social-icon { font-size: 1.1rem; }
  .contact-info {
    font-size: 0.9rem; color: rgba(229,231,235,0.5);
    line-height: 2;
  }
  .contact-info a { color: var(--sky); text-decoration: none; transition: color 0.3s; }
  .contact-info a:hover { color: var(--neon); }

  /* ===== FOOTER ===== */
  footer {
    border-top: 1px solid var(--glass-border);
    padding: 2.5rem 5%;
    display: flex; align-items: center; justify-content: space-between;
    flex-wrap: wrap; gap: 1rem;
    background: rgba(11,18,32,0.5);
  }
  .footer-logo {
    font-family: 'Montserrat', sans-serif;
    font-weight: 800;
    font-size: 1.1rem;
    background: linear-gradient(135deg, var(--sky), var(--neon));
    -webkit-background-clip: text; -webkit-text-fill-color: transparent;
    letter-spacing: 0.15em;
  }
  .footer-copy {
    font-size: 0.75rem; color: rgba(229,231,235,0.35);
    letter-spacing: 0.05em;
  }

  /* ===== MODAL ===== */
  .modal-overlay {
    position: fixed; inset: 0; z-index: 9990;
    background: rgba(11,18,32,0.85);
    backdrop-filter: blur(16px);
    display: none; align-items: center; justify-content: center;
    padding: 1.5rem;
  }
  .modal-overlay.open { display: flex; }
  .modal {
    background: linear-gradient(135deg, rgba(11,18,32,0.98), rgba(30,58,138,0.15));
    border: 1px solid var(--glass-border);
    border-radius: 8px;
    padding: 2.5rem;
    width: 100%; max-width: 440px;
    position: relative;
    box-shadow: 0 0 80px rgba(59,130,246,0.2);
    animation: modalIn 0.4s cubic-bezier(0.34, 1.56, 0.64, 1) both;
  }
  @keyframes modalIn { from { opacity: 0; transform: scale(0.9) translateY(20px); } }
  .modal-close {
    position: absolute; top: 1.2rem; right: 1.2rem;
    width: 30px; height: 30px;
    border: 1px solid var(--glass-border);
    background: transparent;
    color: var(--silver);
    border-radius: 50%;
    cursor: pointer;
    font-size: 1rem;
    display: flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center;
    transition: all 0.3s;
  }
  .modal-close:hover { border-color: var(--neon); color: var(--neon); }
  .modal-title {
    font-family: 'Montserrat', sans-serif;
    font-size: 1.6rem; font-weight: 800;
    margin-bottom: 0.4rem; color: var(--silver);
  }
  .modal-sub { font-size: 0.85rem; color: rgba(229,231,235,0.5); margin-bottom: 2rem; }
  .modal-form { display: flex; flex-direction: column; gap: 1rem; }
  .modal-tabs {
    display: flex; gap: 0; margin-bottom: 2rem;
    border: 1px solid var(--glass-border);
    border-radius: 4px; overflow: hidden;
  }
  .modal-tab {
    flex: 1; padding: 0.7rem;
    font-family: 'Montserrat', sans-serif;
    font-size: 0.75rem; font-weight: 700;
    letter-spacing: 0.1em; text-transform: uppercase;
    background: transparent;
    border: none; color: rgba(229,231,235,0.5);
    cursor: pointer; transition: all 0.3s;
  }
  .modal-tab.active {
    background: rgba(59,130,246,0.15);
    color: var(--sky);
  }
  .btn-modal-submit {
    padding: 0.9rem;
    font-family: 'Montserrat', sans-serif;
    font-size: 0.8rem; font-weight: 700;
    letter-spacing: 0.15em; text-transform: uppercase;
    background: linear-gradient(135deg, var(--electric), var(--purple));
    border: none; border-radius: 4px;
    color: #fff; cursor: pointer;
    transition: all 0.3s;
    margin-top: 0.5rem;
  }
  .btn-modal-submit:hover {
    box-shadow: 0 0 40px rgba(59,130,246,0.5);
    transform: translateY(-1px);
  }
  .modal-divider {
    text-align: center; font-size: 0.75rem;
    color: rgba(229,231,235,0.35);
    margin: 0.5rem 0;
    position: relative;
  }
  .modal-divider::before, .modal-divider::after {
    content: '';
    position: absolute; top: 50%;
    width: calc(50% - 2rem);
    height: 1px;
    background: var(--glass-border);
  }
  .modal-divider::before { left: 0; }
  .modal-divider::after { right: 0; }
  .modal-switch {
    text-align: center; font-size: 0.8rem;
    color: rgba(229,231,235,0.45);
  }
  .modal-switch a { color: var(--sky); cursor: pointer; text-decoration: none; }
  .modal-switch a:hover { color: var(--neon); }
  .modal-alert {
    padding: 0.7rem 1rem;
    border-radius: 4px;
    font-size: 0.8rem;
    display: none;
  }
  .modal-alert.success { background: rgba(34,211,238,0.1); border: 1px solid rgba(34,211,238,0.3); color: var(--neon); }
  .modal-alert.error { background: rgba(239,68,68,0.1); border: 1px solid rgba(239,68,68,0.3); color: #f87171; }

  /* ===== ANIMATIONS ===== */
  @keyframes fadeSlideDown { from { opacity: 0; transform: translateY(-20px); } to { opacity: 1; transform: translateY(0); } }
  @keyframes fadeSlideUp { from { opacity: 0; transform: translateY(30px); } to { opacity: 1; transform: translateY(0); } }

  .reveal {
    opacity: 0;
    transform: translateY(40px);
    transition: opacity 0.8s ease, transform 0.8s ease;
  }
  .reveal.visible {
    opacity: 1;
    transform: translateY(0);
  }
  .reveal-delay-1 { transition-delay: 0.1s; }
  .reveal-delay-2 { transition-delay: 0.2s; }
  .reveal-delay-3 { transition-delay: 0.3s; }
  .reveal-delay-4 { transition-delay: 0.4s; }
  .reveal-delay-5 { transition-delay: 0.5s; }

  /* ===== DECORATIVE LINES ===== */
  .neon-line {
    height: 1px;
    background: linear-gradient(90deg, transparent, var(--neon), transparent);
    box-shadow: 0 0 10px rgba(34,211,238,0.4);
    margin: 0;
  }

  /* ===== RESPONSIVE ===== */
  @media (max-width: 900px) {
    .about-grid { grid-template-columns: 1fr; gap: 3rem; }
    .form-row { grid-template-columns: 1fr; }
  }
  @media (max-width: 768px) {
    section { padding: 5rem 5%; }
    .nav-links, .nav-cta { display: none; }
    .hamburger { display: flex; }
    .hero-title { font-size: clamp(2.5rem, 11vw, 5rem); }
    .models-grid { grid-template-columns: 1fr; }
    footer { flex-direction: column; text-align: center; }
    body { cursor: auto; }
    .cursor, .cursor-ring { display: none; }
  }
</style>
</head>
<body>

<!-- CURSOR -->
<div class="cursor" id="cursor"></div>
<div class="cursor-ring" id="cursorRing"></div>

<!-- NAV -->
<nav id="navbar">
  <a href="#" class="nav-logo">VANTOR<span>.</span></a>
  <ul class="nav-links">
    <li><a href="#models">Models</a></li>
    <li><a href="#experience">Experience</a></li>
    <li><a href="#about">About</a></li>
    <li><a href="#booking">Reserve</a></li>
    <li><a href="#contact">Contact</a></li>
  </ul>
  <div class="nav-cta">
    <button class="btn-nav btn-ghost" onclick="openModal('login')">Sign In</button>
    <button class="btn-nav btn-primary" onclick="openModal('signup')">Join</button>
  </div>
  <div class="hamburger" id="hamburger" onclick="toggleMenu()">
    <span></span><span></span><span></span>
  </div>
</nav>

<!-- MOBILE MENU -->
<div class="mobile-menu" id="mobileMenu">
  <a href="#models" onclick="toggleMenu()">Models</a>
  <a href="#experience" onclick="toggleMenu()">Experience</a>
  <a href="#about" onclick="toggleMenu()">About</a>
  <a href="#booking" onclick="toggleMenu()">Reserve</a>
  <a href="#contact" onclick="toggleMenu()">Contact</a>
  <button class="btn-nav btn-primary" onclick="openModal('login');toggleMenu()">Sign In</button>
</div>

<!-- HERO -->
<section id="hero">
  <div class="hero-bg-img">
    <div class="hero-slide active" style="background-image:url('https://images.unsplash.com/photo-1492144534655-ae79c964c9d7?w=1920&q=90')"></div>
    <div class="hero-slide" style="background-image:url('https://images.unsplash.com/photo-1544636331-e26879cd4d9b?w=1920&q=90')"></div>
    <div class="hero-slide" style="background-image:url('https://images.unsplash.com/photo-1580274455191-1c62238fa333?w=1920&q=90')"></div>
    <div class="hero-slide" style="background-image:url('https://images.unsplash.com/photo-1503376780353-7e6692767b70?w=1920&q=90')"></div>
    <div class="hero-slide" style="background-image:url('https://images.unsplash.com/photo-1555215695-3004980ad54e?w=1920&q=90')"></div>
  </div>
  <div class="hero-dots" id="heroDots">
    <div class="hero-dot active" onclick="goSlide(0)"></div>
    <div class="hero-dot" onclick="goSlide(1)"></div>
    <div class="hero-dot" onclick="goSlide(2)"></div>
    <div class="hero-dot" onclick="goSlide(3)"></div>
    <div class="hero-dot" onclick="goSlide(4)"></div>
  </div>
  <div class="hero-overlay"></div>
  <div class="hero-glow-l"></div>
  <div class="hero-glow-r"></div>
  <div class="hero-content">
    <div class="hero-badge">New Era of Automotive Excellence</div>
    <h1 class="hero-title">
      <span class="line1">Drive the</span>
      <span class="line2">Future</span>
    </h1>
    <p class="hero-sub">Luxury <span>·</span> Performance <span>·</span> Innovation</p>
    <div class="hero-buttons">
      <a href="#models" class="btn-hero-primary">Explore Models</a>
      <a href="#booking" class="btn-hero-ghost">Reserve Yours</a>
    </div>
  </div>
  <div class="hero-scroll">
    <div class="scroll-line"></div>
    <span>Scroll</span>
  </div>
</section>

<!-- STATS BAR -->
<div class="stats-bar">
  <div class="stat-item reveal">
    <span class="stat-num" data-count="0.0" data-target="2.1" data-decimal="1">2.1s</span>
    <span class="stat-label">0–100 km/h</span>
  </div>
  <div class="stat-item reveal reveal-delay-1">
    <span class="stat-num" data-count="0" data-target="1200" data-suffix="HP">1200 HP</span>
    <span class="stat-label">Peak Power</span>
  </div>
  <div class="stat-item reveal reveal-delay-2">
    <span class="stat-num" data-count="0" data-target="360" data-suffix="km/h">360 km/h</span>
    <span class="stat-label">Top Speed</span>
  </div>
  <div class="stat-item reveal reveal-delay-3">
    <span class="stat-num" data-count="0" data-target="700" data-suffix="km">700 km</span>
    <span class="stat-label">Range</span>
  </div>
</div>

<!-- MODELS -->
<section id="models">
  <div class="models-header reveal">
    <div class="section-tag">Our Fleet</div>
    <h2 class="section-title">The Vantor <span class="accent">Collection</span></h2>
    <p class="section-sub">Six masterpieces engineered to redefine what a car can be. Each model a different story — all of them extraordinary.</p>
  </div>
  <div class="models-grid">

    <div class="car-card reveal reveal-delay-1">
      <div class="car-glow"></div>
      <img class="car-card-img" src="https://images.unsplash.com/photo-1544636331-e26879cd4d9b?w=800&q=85" alt="Vantor Apex" loading="lazy">
      <div class="car-card-body">
        <span class="car-badge">Hypercar</span>
        <div class="car-name">Vantor Apex</div>
        <div class="car-tagline">Born on the track. Made for legends.</div>
        <div class="car-specs">
          <div class="spec"><div class="spec-val">1200</div><div class="spec-key">HP</div></div>
          <div class="spec"><div class="spec-val">2.1s</div><div class="spec-key">0–100</div></div>
          <div class="spec"><div class="spec-val">360</div><div class="spec-key">km/h</div></div>
        </div>
        <div class="car-price">$1,850,000</div>
        <button class="car-btn" onclick="selectCar('Vantor Apex', 1850000)">Reserve Now</button>
      </div>
    </div>

    <div class="car-card reveal reveal-delay-2">
      <div class="car-glow"></div>
      <img class="car-card-img" src="https://images.unsplash.com/photo-1580274455191-1c62238fa333?w=800&q=85" alt="Vantor Meridian" loading="lazy">
      <div class="car-card-body">
        <span class="car-badge">Grand Tourer</span>
        <div class="car-name">Vantor Meridian</div>
        <div class="car-tagline">Cross continents in unmatched grace.</div>
        <div class="car-specs">
          <div class="spec"><div class="spec-val">850</div><div class="spec-key">HP</div></div>
          <div class="spec"><div class="spec-val">2.8s</div><div class="spec-key">0–100</div></div>
          <div class="spec"><div class="spec-val">700km</div><div class="spec-key">Range</div></div>
        </div>
        <div class="car-price">$1,120,000</div>
        <button class="car-btn" onclick="selectCar('Vantor Meridian', 1120000)">Reserve Now</button>
      </div>
    </div>

    <div class="car-card reveal reveal-delay-3">
      <div class="car-glow"></div>
      <img class="car-card-img" src="https://images.unsplash.com/photo-1555215695-3004980ad54e?w=800&q=85" alt="Vantor Nova" loading="lazy">
      <div class="car-card-body">
        <span class="car-badge">Sport EV</span>
        <div class="car-name">Vantor Nova</div>
        <div class="car-tagline">Pure electric. Pure adrenaline.</div>
        <div class="car-specs">
          <div class="spec"><div class="spec-val">750</div><div class="spec-key">HP</div></div>
          <div class="spec"><div class="spec-val">3.1s</div><div class="spec-key">0–100</div></div>
          <div class="spec"><div class="spec-val">620km</div><div class="spec-key">Range</div></div>
        </div>
        <div class="car-price">$720,000</div>
        <button class="car-btn" onclick="selectCar('Vantor Nova', 720000)">Reserve Now</button>
      </div>
    </div>

    <div class="car-card reveal reveal-delay-1">
      <div class="car-glow"></div>
      <img class="car-card-img" src="https://images.unsplash.com/photo-1503376780353-7e6692767b70?w=800&q=85" alt="Vantor Eclipse" loading="lazy">
      <div class="car-card-body">
        <span class="car-badge">Luxury Sedan</span>
        <div class="car-name">Vantor Eclipse</div>
        <div class="car-tagline">Where opulence meets velocity.</div>
        <div class="car-specs">
          <div class="spec"><div class="spec-val">640</div><div class="spec-key">HP</div></div>
          <div class="spec"><div class="spec-val">3.5s</div><div class="spec-key">0–100</div></div>
          <div class="spec"><div class="spec-val">580km</div><div class="spec-key">Range</div></div>
        </div>
        <div class="car-price">$480,000</div>
        <button class="car-btn" onclick="selectCar('Vantor Eclipse', 480000)">Reserve Now</button>
      </div>
    </div>

    <div class="car-card reveal reveal-delay-2">
      <div class="car-glow"></div>
      <img class="car-card-img" src="https://images.unsplash.com/photo-1541899481282-d53bffe3c35d?w=800&q=85" alt="Vantor Solaris" loading="lazy">
      <div class="car-card-body">
        <span class="car-badge">SUV Luxury</span>
        <div class="car-name">Vantor Solaris</div>
        <div class="car-tagline">Commanding. Composed. Unstoppable.</div>
        <div class="car-specs">
          <div class="spec"><div class="spec-val">580</div><div class="spec-key">HP</div></div>
          <div class="spec"><div class="spec-val">3.9s</div><div class="spec-key">0–100</div></div>
          <div class="spec"><div class="spec-val">540km</div><div class="spec-key">Range</div></div>
        </div>
        <div class="car-price">$390,000</div>
        <button class="car-btn" onclick="selectCar('Vantor Solaris', 390000)">Reserve Now</button>
      </div>
    </div>

    <div class="car-card reveal reveal-delay-3">
      <div class="car-glow"></div>
      <img class="car-card-img" src="https://images.unsplash.com/photo-1494976388531-d1058494cdd8?w=800&q=85" alt="Vantor Aurora" loading="lazy">
      <div class="car-card-body">
        <span class="car-badge">Entry Luxury</span>
        <div class="car-name">Vantor Aurora</div>
        <div class="car-tagline">Your first step into legend.</div>
        <div class="car-specs">
          <div class="spec"><div class="spec-val">420</div><div class="spec-key">HP</div></div>
          <div class="spec"><div class="spec-val">4.2s</div><div class="spec-key">0–100</div></div>
          <div class="spec"><div class="spec-val">500km</div><div class="spec-key">Range</div></div>
        </div>
        <div class="car-price">$230,000</div>

  </div>
</section>

<div class="neon-line"></div>

<!-- EXPERIENCE / VIDEO -->
<section id="experience">
  <div class="experience-inner">
    <div class="section-tag reveal">The Experience</div>
    <h2 class="section-title reveal">Feel the <span class="accent">Power</span></h2>
    <p class="section-sub reveal">Step inside the world of Vantor. Watch how we push the boundaries of speed, luxury, and innovation — one breathtaking second at a time.</p>
    <div class="video-frame reveal">
      <video
        src="data:video/mp4;base64,"
        controls
        autoplay
        muted
        loop
        playsinline
        style="width:100%;height:100%;object-fit:cover;display:block;">
        Your browser does not support the video tag.
      </video>
    </div>
  </div>
</section>

<div class="neon-line"></div>

<!-- ABOUT -->
<section id="about">
  <div class="about-grid" style="max-width:1200px; margin:0 auto;">
    <div class="about-visual reveal">
      <img class="about-img"
        src="https://images.unsplash.com/photo-1514316703755-dca7d7d9d882?w=900&q=85"
        alt="Vantor Automotive Brand Story">
      <div class="about-visual-glow"></div>
    </div>
    <div class="about-text reveal reveal-delay-2">
      <div class="section-tag">Our Story</div>
      <h2 class="section-title">Crafted for the <span class="accent">Extraordinary</span></h2>
      <p>Vantor Automotive was born from a singular obsession: to create machines that transcend transportation and become extensions of human ambition. Founded in 2018 by a team of aerospace engineers and luxury designers, we set out to reimagine what a car could be.</p>
      <p>Every Vantor is a statement — not just of wealth or taste, but of vision. We blend the precision of Formula 1 engineering with the soul of haute couture, producing fewer than 500 vehicles per year. Each one is handcrafted over 1,800 hours by master artisans who treat metal, carbon fiber, and leather as living mediums.</p>
      <p>We don't build cars. We compose symphonies that happen to travel at 360 km/h.</p>
      <div class="about-pills">
        <span class="pill">Founded 2018</span>
        <span class="pill">Handcrafted</span>

<!-- LOGIN / SIGNUP MODAL -->
<div class="modal-overlay" id="authModal" onclick="handleOverlayClick(event)">
  <div class="modal">
    <button class="modal-close" onclick="closeModal()">✕</button>
    <div class="modal-tabs">
      <button class="modal-tab active" id="tabLogin" onclick="switchTab('login')">Sign In</button>
      <button class="modal-tab" id="tabSignup" onclick="switchTab('signup')">Create Account</button>
    </div>

    <!-- LOGIN FORM -->
    <div id="loginForm">
      <div class="modal-title">Welcome Back</div>
      <div class="modal-sub">Sign in to your Vantor account</div>
      <div class="modal-form">
        <div class="modal-alert" id="loginAlert"></div>
        <div class="form-group">
          <label class="form-label">Email</label>
          <input type="email" class="form-control" id="loginEmail" placeholder="your@email.com">
        </div>

          <label class="form-label">Password</label>
          <input type="password" class="form-control" id="loginPassword" placeholder="••••••••">
        </div>
        <button class="btn-modal-submit" onclick="handleLogin()">Sign In</button>
        <div class="modal-switch">Don't have an account? <a onclick="switchTab('signup')">Create one</a></div>
      </div>
    </div>

    <!-- SIGNUP FORM -->
    <div id="signupForm" style="display:none">
      <div class="modal-title">Join Vantor</div>
      <div class="modal-sub">Create your exclusive membership</div>
      <div class="modal-form">
        <div class="modal-alert" id="signupAlert"></div>
        <div class="form-group">
          <label class="form-label">Full Name</label>
          <input type="text" class="form-control" id="signupName" placeholder="Your full name">
        </div>

          <label class="form-label">Email</label>
          <input type="email" class="form-control" id="signupEmail" placeholder="your@email.com">
        </div>
        <div class="form-group">
          <label class="form-label">Password</label>
          <input type="password" class="form-control" id="signupPassword" placeholder="Min. 6 characters">
        </div>
        <button class="btn-modal-submit" onclick="handleSignup()">Create Account</button>
        <div class="modal-switch">Already a member? <a onclick="switchTab('login')">Sign in</a></div>
      </div>

  </div>

<script data-cfasync="false" src="/cdn-cgi/scripts/5c5dd728/cloudflare-static/email-decode.min.js"></script><script>
/* ===== CURSOR ===== */
const cursor = document.getElementById('cursor');
const ring = document.getElementById('cursorRing');
let mx=0,my=0,rx=0,ry=0;
document.addEventListener('mousemove', e => { mx=e.clientX; my=e.clientY; cursor.style.left=mx+'px'; cursor.style.top=my+'px'; });
function animRing(){
  rx+=(mx-rx)*0.15; ry+=(my-ry)*0.15;
  ring.style.left=rx+'px'; ring.style.top=ry+'px';
  requestAnimationFrame(animRing);
}
animRing();
document.querySelectorAll('a,button,.car-card,.social-btn').forEach(el=>{
  el.addEventListener('mouseenter',()=>{ cursor.style.width='20px'; cursor.style.height='20px'; ring.style.width='50px'; ring.style.height='50px'; ring.style.borderColor='rgba(34,211,238,0.8)'; });
  el.addEventListener('mouseleave',()=>{ cursor.style.width='12px'; cursor.style.height='12px'; ring.style.width='36px'; ring.style.height='36px'; ring.style.borderColor='rgba(34,211,238,0.5)'; });
});

/* ===== NAV SCROLL ===== */
window.addEventListener('scroll',()=>{
  document.getElementById('navbar').classList.toggle('scrolled', window.scrollY > 60);
});

/* ===== MOBILE MENU ===== */
function toggleMenu(){
  document.getElementById('mobileMenu').classList.toggle('open');
}

/* ===== SCROLL REVEAL ===== */
const revealEls = document.querySelectorAll('.reveal');
const observer = new IntersectionObserver(entries=>{
  entries.forEach(e=>{ if(e.isIntersecting) e.target.classList.add('visible'); });
}, { threshold: 0.1 });
revealEls.forEach(el=>observer.observe(el));

/* ===== MODAL ===== */
function openModal(tab='login'){
  document.getElementById('authModal').classList.add('open');
  document.body.style.overflow='hidden';
  switchTab(tab);
}
function closeModal(){
  document.getElementById('authModal').classList.remove('open');
  document.body.style.overflow='';
}
function handleOverlayClick(e){
  if(e.target === document.getElementById('authModal')) closeModal();
}
function switchTab(tab){
  const isLogin = tab==='login';
  document.getElementById('loginForm').style.display = isLogin?'block':'none';
  document.getElementById('signupForm').style.display = isLogin?'none':'block';
  document.getElementById('tabLogin').classList.toggle('active', isLogin);
  document.getElementById('tabSignup').classList.toggle('active', !isLogin);
}
document.addEventListener('keydown',e=>{ if(e.key==='Escape') closeModal(); });

/* ===== AUTH ===== */
function showAlert(id, msg, type){
  const el = document.getElementById(id);
  el.textContent = msg;
  el.className = 'modal-alert '+type;
  el.style.display = 'block';
}
function handleLogin(){
  const email = document.getElementById('loginEmail').value.trim();
  const pass = document.getElementById('loginPassword').value;
  if(!email||!pass){ showAlert('loginAlert','Please fill in all fields.','error'); return; }
  const users = JSON.parse(localStorage.getItem('vantor_users')||'{}');
  if(!users[email]){ showAlert('loginAlert','Account not found. Please sign up.','error'); return; }
  if(users[email].password !== pass){ showAlert('loginAlert','Incorrect password.','error'); return; }
  localStorage.setItem('vantor_session', JSON.stringify({email, name: users[email].name}));
  showAlert('loginAlert','Welcome back, '+users[email].name+'! ✦','success');
  setTimeout(closeModal, 1500);
}
function handleSignup(){
  const name = document.getElementById('signupName').value.trim();
  const email = document.getElementById('signupEmail').value.trim();
  const pass = document.getElementById('signupPassword').value;
  if(!name||!email||!pass){ showAlert('signupAlert','Please fill in all fields.','error'); return; }
  if(pass.length<6){ showAlert('signupAlert','Password must be at least 6 characters.','error'); return; }
  const users = JSON.parse(localStorage.getItem('vantor_users')||'{}');
  if(users[email]){ showAlert('signupAlert','An account with this email already exists.','error'); return; }
  users[email] = { name, password: pass };
  localStorage.setItem('vantor_users', JSON.stringify(users));
  localStorage.setItem('vantor_session', JSON.stringify({email, name}));
  showAlert('signupAlert','Welcome to Vantor, '+name+'! ✦','success');
  setTimeout(closeModal, 1500);
}

/* ===== BOOKING ===== */
function selectCar(name, price){
  document.getElementById('bookCar').value = price;
  updatePrice();
  document.getElementById('booking').scrollIntoView({behavior:'smooth'});
}
function updatePrice(){
  const val = +document.getElementById('bookCar').value;
  const deposit = val > 0 ? '$25,000' : '$25,000';
  document.getElementById('bookPrice').textContent = deposit;
}
function submitBooking(){
  const name = document.getElementById('bookName').value.trim();
  const email = document.getElementById('bookEmail').value.trim();
  const car = document.getElementById('bookCar').value;
  if(!name || !email){ alert('Please enter your name and email to reserve.'); return; }
  if(car === '0'){ alert('Please select a model to reserve.'); return; }
  const btn = document.querySelector('.btn-book');
  btn.textContent = 'Processing...';
  btn.disabled = true;
  setTimeout(()=>{
    btn.style.display = 'none';
    document.getElementById('bookingSuccess').style.display = 'block';
    localStorage.setItem('vantor_reservation', JSON.stringify({name,email,car,date: new Date().toISOString()}));
  }, 1800);
}

/* ===== HERO SLIDESHOW ===== */
let slideIndex = 0;
const slides = document.querySelectorAll('.hero-slide');
const dots = document.querySelectorAll('.hero-dot');
function goSlide(n) {
  slides[slideIndex].classList.remove('active');
  dots[slideIndex].classList.remove('active');
  slideIndex = (n + slides.length) % slides.length;
  slides[slideIndex].classList.add('active');
  dots[slideIndex].classList.add('active');
}
setInterval(() => goSlide(slideIndex + 1), 5000);

function animateCounters(){
  document.querySelectorAll('[data-target]').forEach(el=>{
    const target = parseFloat(el.dataset.target);
    const decimal = el.dataset.decimal ? 1 : 0;
    const suffix = el.dataset.suffix || (decimal ? 's' : '');
    let start = 0;
    const duration = 2000;
    const step = (timestamp) => {
      if(!start) start = timestamp;
      const progress = Math.min((timestamp - start) / duration, 1);
      const ease = 1 - Math.pow(1-progress, 3);
      const val = (target * ease);
      el.textContent = (decimal ? val.toFixed(1) : Math.round(val)) + suffix;
      if(progress < 1
